name: zonetwo
description: Turn your running history into a training plan, on your watch. Works with Garmin Connect.
long_description:
Zone Two reads your own Garmin Connect history so Claude can do something useful with it: look at what you have actually been running, design a plan that fits it, and put each session on your watch as a structured workout.

Ask it to build a half marathon plan from your last six months, to tell you whether you are ready for intervals today, or to export your running history as a spreadsheet — the export Garmin makes awkward.

Sign in once. Enter your Garmin email and password below; if your account uses two-step verification, Garmin emails a code and Claude asks for it in the conversation. After that a saved token keeps you signed in for about a year.

Everything runs on your own computer. Requests go straight to Garmin — there is no server in between and no analytics of any kind. Zone Two can create and schedule workouts, and it can never delete a recorded activity. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin.

email.title: Garmin email
email.description: The email address you sign in to Garmin Connect with.

password.title: Garmin password
password.description: Used once to obtain an access token, then stored only by Claude Desktop. Zone Two never writes it to disk.

enable_record_edits.title: Let Claude edit my Garmin records
enable_record_edits.description: Off by default. Scheduling workouts always works; this adds renaming activities and logging weight or hydration. Recorded activities can never be deleted either way.
